answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a pigment bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every horizon settlement recomputes the dawn schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
